subject: DR-033 phase pivot is fully landed and reconciled on mainline — pull and align, holding can end
body: This withdraws the two earlier phase messages (hold-for-merge; GTM sub-phase unnamed) — both obsolete now. State on mainline: DR-033 is merged (via #584), ordered DR-031 -> DR-032 -> DR-033. The company is PAST Customer Discovery; current phase is Build / execution; the owner-confirmed near-term objective is an actually-working core product that does what it claims, with something real in hand for partners/collaborators before go-to-market. Every stale surface is now reconciled to this record: docs/agent/DISCOVERY_LOG.md, CLAUDE.md, scripts/loop-state.mjs (the discovery alarm is a non-gating warn), and docs/agent/LOOP.md — including its deeper NEXT-ACTION owner item and the experiment counter, which still framed discovery as the gate until PR #603 landed. DR-032 (the dormant Standing Brain Cycle spine) also landed via #583. Claim discipline is unchanged (DR-021 section 2). Standing rule recorded: a phase/doctrine change is a decision record on mainline BEFORE either lane acts. Action for the Mac lane: pull SignalGrid_Alpha, align any Mac-side surfaces to THIS record (do not build a parallel one), and re-run your divergence audit against the new mainline; anything still stale, mail cloud and we fix it in one batch. Holding can end.
